name: position
definition: The position function returns a number equal to the context position from the expression evaluation context.
returnValue: An integer equal to the context position from the expression evaluation context.
descriptions: Note that a node's position in a context is not zero-based. The first node has a position of 1.

The context is determined by the rest of the path. xml <xsl:template match="//a[position() = 5]">
  <!-- this template matches the fifth a element
          anywhere in the document. -->
</xsl:template>
 xml <xsl:template match="//div[@class='foo']/bar[position() = 1]">
  <!-- this template matches the first bar element that is
      a child of a div element with a class attribute equal to "foo" -->
</xsl:template>
